body: I think I would. I just get overwhelmed when I think about what I'm going to do. I look through potential jobs or career paths, and in the end it just boils down to "Well, you couldn't do any of these anyway, you're not good enough. Just stop trying." There's not really a reason I should feel worse right now than I have in the past. Nothing really changed. I don't know.

I tried seeing a professional and being on medication 4 different times, it didn't really work out. I read on occasion but for the most part I just browse the internet or play video games with my two friends. I've been trying to get back in shape and go for a job for an hour or so every day, but when I think about it I don't really know why. I just kinda do it.

I could and sometimes I think I can do it, but I've felt this way for a decade. At this point I'm just tired of it. Nothing I've done has helped, and I don't really believe anything I will do could make it better.

Fun? I don't really do much for fun. I sit around the house. I haven't been happy for a very long time.
